title: 数据管道与质量
scope: Data contracts, row grain, schema evolution, incremental ingestion, replay and reconciliation.
routingDescription: Data contracts, row grain, schema evolution, incremental ingestion, replay and reconciliation.
useWhen: Missing or duplicated records after ingestion
Metrics changed after schema or pipeline changes

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use statistical inference once the underlying data and sampling unit are trustworthy.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Define what one row means, keys, units, time zone, freshness and source-to-target contract.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Resolve contradictory grains before joins or aggregation.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Check deduplication keys, watermarks, late data and idempotent output semantics.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Specify whether replay replaces, merges or duplicates data.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Compare source and target counts, key coverage and aggregates at matching grain and time windows.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Locate the first stage where evidence diverges.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Check old records, type coercion, null handling, defaults and quarantined bad rows.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Preserve rejected rows and make compatibility failures visible.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When a new data platform is proposed
diagnosticChecklist.check: Compare measured size, latency and operational constraints with the current pipeline.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Choose the smallest reliable change and justify infrastructure additions.

evidenceRequirements: Data dictionary with key, grain, unit and time zone
Source and target counts plus rejected-row records
Watermark/replay policy and representative old/new schemas
qualityChecks: Counts and aggregates reconcile at the same grain
Failures preserve evidence rather than silently dropping rows
Architecture follows actual throughput and freshness needs
riskRules: Backfills and retention changes may be irreversible and require a separately reviewed execution plan

preferredSources: Versioned source/target schemas and connector guarantees
Source-owned data dictionaries, watermark semantics and reconciliation records
knowledgePolicy.onMissing: Bound the conclusion and state which current source or evidence is needed.

examples.input: A CDC backfill doubled revenue although no orders changed.
examples.expected: Check row grain, replay deduplication and source-to-target reconciliation.
examples.reject: Interpret the doubled revenue as business growth.

adaptations: Converted task execution instructions into conditional consultation checks.
Removed persona, memory claims, model selection and tool grants.
Replaced unconditional numerical targets with context-specific evidence requirements.
